python.scope: Console CPython and backend stdlib; optional Tk/IDLE and x86-only launcher excluded. Original installer preserved as provenance.

manager.configuration: Existing schema/profile/lifecycle unchanged; ReaderManager receives optional concrete executable bindings from authenticated app composition. Config bytes are not rewritten.
manager.composition: Parent and managed child authenticate their own app seal/release/manifest and inject the same local ReaderExecutables. No env or HTTP binding authority.

trustStore.policy: Official Python installer recommended certifi trust data, process-local only; no account, keychain or system changes.

capabilities.rawDiffNativeConsumer: unverified; immutable PDF full reset only
